title: pty.master_open and slave_open are deprecated
summary: Python 3.12 gives the undocumented pty.master_open() and pty.slave_open() a DeprecationWarning, to be removed in Python 3.14.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

steps.title: Use pty.openpty
steps.instructions: Replace both calls with a single pty.openpty() that returns the master and slave file descriptors.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
